切换界面语言，不中断串口连接。: Change the interface language without interrupting the serial connection.
选择触觉板串口，也可直接输入串口名称；点击连接后才会打开。: Select or enter the tactile device's serial port. The port opens only when you click Connect.
接收频率指本窗口收到的不同源触觉快照，不是设备扫描频率。: The receive rate counts distinct tactile snapshots received by this window, not device scans.
拖动旋转 · 滚轮缩放: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom
选择触觉串口，然后点击连接。: Select a tactile serial port, then click Connect.
正在释放串口，请稍候再关闭窗口。: Releasing the serial port. Please wait before closing the window.
已配置固定手模型，无需安装或配置模型运行环境。: The fixed hand model is included. No model environment needs to be installed or configured.
选择可信 MANO 资源目录: Select a trusted MANO assets folder
模型设置已保存，正在加载。: Model settings saved. Loading the model.
{detail} 历史画面已保持。: {detail} The last frame is retained as history.
当前数据不可用，保留上一有效画面（历史保持）。: Current data is unavailable. The last valid frame is retained as history.
参数含义与主程序一致，设置仅保存到本工具。: Settings have the same meaning as in the main application and are saved only for this tool.
保持触觉区域不受压，采集 3 秒无载参考。: Keep all tactile areas unloaded while the reference is collected for 3 seconds.
请保持触觉区域不受压，然后点击“无载归零”。: Keep all tactile areas unloaded, then click Zero unloaded reference.
颜色表示相对触觉响应，不是压力；灰色表示无效或缺少参考。: Colors show relative tactile response, not pressure. Gray means invalid data or a missing reference.
色阶从 0 到此数值固定显示，不自动放大无载噪声。: The color scale stays fixed from 0 to this value; unloaded noise is not automatically amplified.
双向变化显示相对参考的变化幅度；已知硬件响应方向时可选择增大或减小。: Both directions shows the magnitude of change from the reference. Choose increases or decreases when the sensor response direction is known.
有效采样不足，请保持无载后重试。: Not enough valid samples. Keep the sensors unloaded and retry.
采集中断，请恢复数据后重新归零。: Reference collection was interrupted. Restore the data stream and zero again.
数据流已切换，请重新归零。: The data stream changed. Acquire a new unloaded reference.
数据时间异常，请重新归零。: Data timing is invalid. Acquire a new unloaded reference.
采样无效，请重新归零。: Samples are invalid. Acquire a new unloaded reference.
参考无效，请保持无载后重新归零。: The reference is invalid. Keep the sensors unloaded and zero again.
需要新鲜触觉数据才能采集无载参考。: Fresh tactile data is required to collect an unloaded reference.
当前数据源未启用触觉响应显示。: Tactile response display is not enabled for this data source.
触觉响应需要有效参考状态和从零开始的固定色阶: Tactile response requires a valid reference state and a fixed color scale starting at zero.
无载参考差值，不代表压力。: Change from the unloaded reference, not pressure.
按固定范围显示相对参考的响应；范围越小，同一变化的颜色越明显。: Responses relative to the reference use a fixed range. A smaller range makes the same change more visible.
可选：保持触觉区域不受压，采集 3 秒新参考。: Optional: keep all tactile areas unloaded to collect a new reference for 3 seconds.
已载入匹配设备的默认参考，可直接查看触觉响应。: The default reference for this device is loaded. Tactile responses are ready to view.
已恢复此设备的已保存参考，可直接查看触觉响应。: The saved reference for this device is restored. Tactile responses are ready to view.
已载入通用参考，可直接查看触觉响应；如有无载偏差，可选无载归零。: A general reference is loaded and responses are ready to view. Zeroing is optional if unloaded offsets remain.
